thought: She was born without arms. At 17, she became the best archer on Earth.
support: Sheetal Devi, from a small village in Jammu and Kashmir, was born with phocomelia and had never seen a bow before age 15. A physical test revealed unusual upper-body strength, and she took up archery in 2021 - learning to draw and release using her feet and shoulder instead of hands. At the Paris 2024 Paralympics, aged 17, she became India's youngest-ever Paralympic medallist. In March 2026, she won the compound women's world title at the World Archery Para Championships, becoming the first armless woman in history crowned a world para archery champion.
